mu_name_from: OpenMU VersionSeasonSix's CreateArmor (openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/VersionSeasonSix/Items/Armors.cs:203); the model is Player/PantMale28.bmd, which MuMain's OpenItems loads for it (MuMain/src/source/Engine/Object/ZzzOpenData.cpp:213).

why_this_one: The Dark Lord's third set, Dark Steel (docs/plans/dark-lord-gear.md batch 2; OpenMU's rows, drop 75-96, lords only; Sky Door and Phoenix pay it). The user, 2026-10-25: 'we need missing Dark lord items', 'do it'.
sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py under MU's own names (Kmpp, Kupp, Klpp, Kgpp, Kbpp: blackened steel with gold lion crests); hide is Player/hide (9x9 black), MU's caps over the openings.
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain for the plate, the shading painted on, as Light Plate and Adamantine.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks (studio, 2026-10-04). plate_steel's cast grain instead, shallow for the gloss, as the other sets.
effects_note: MuMain has no render arm for MODEL_DARK_STEEL_* (no glow, no chrome pass, no sprite; grep of MODEL_HELM..BOOTS + 27, docs/plans/dark-lord-gear.md). Its refine colour is PartObjectColor 10, (0.75, 0.65, 0.5) (ZzzObject.cpp:6739-6765, 6788-6818; src/game/shine.cpp); its full set the generic aura (fx/set_shine).
